projectDescription: A multilingual compositional safety evaluation suite that benchmarks AI content-safety pipelines across languages, dialects, and cultural contexts using standards-aligned rubrics and measurement science.
keyFeatures: Multilingual safety evaluation across 100+ languages using XLM-R embeddings
Adaptive Boolean Rubrics — 11-gate auditable pipeline with structured BooleanRubricResult dataclass
BBOM (Benchmark Bill of Materials) supply-chain auditing across 10 compliance layers
LLM-as-Judge with bias-corrected θ̂ estimators and Pydantic structured outputs
Cross-lingual X-Value Consensus/Pluralism framework for value alignment auditing
Human-in-the-Loop triplet active learning for borderline case resolution
IRT-calibrated benchmarks with NIST AI 800-3 GLMM variance decomposition
10-dimension cultural harm taxonomy covering hate, self-harm, political, religious, and historical harms
Self-contained Google Colab notebooks for each evaluation pipeline (v7–v10)
High-throughput CLI evaluator with checkpoint/resume, AMP inference, and multi-worker prefetch
FiftyOne visual dataset curation for multimodal annotation
Standards-aligned with NIST AI 800-3, ISO/IEC 42119-2/3, and MLCommons AILuminate
publicApiSurface: BooleanRubricResult(name, passed, confidence, escalate, severity, reason, evidence)
JSONL record schema: id, prompt_en, prompt_local, culture, language, hazard_tag, image_url, image_sha256, cultural_relevance_score, metadata
Output CSV columns: prompt_id, prompt, response, language, culture, hazard, similarity, safety_label
cultural_taxonomy.yaml — 10-dimension cultural harm taxonomy with subcategories and severity ratings
schema.json — JSON Schema Draft-07 for AILuminate prompt records
Hazard tags: hate, self_harm, political, religious_sensitivity, violence, explicit, historical_trauma, social_norm_violation, language_specific_taboo, generic
Safety labels: Safe, Borderline, Unsafe (cosine-similarity threshold 0.78 default)
Pipeline routing: ONTOLOGICAL_VETO | ROUTED_TO_HUMAN | UNSAFE | SAFE
jury_vote() + route_item() — auditable jury routing replacing entropy threshold
StubEncoder — deterministic offline encoder for CI/network-restricted environments
